title: Grateful Dead Live at Felt Forum, Madison Square Garden on 1971-12-04
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Apogee AD500 -> Dat

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a peak Dead performance at the Felt Forum, highlighted by strong new material and rare songs like Pig's Smokestack Lightnin' and Run Rudolph Run
ai_review.review: The three five‑star reviews rave about this first night of the Felt Forum run as a high‑energy, landmark show – Jerry’s brief pedal‑steel cameo, Phil singing full‑time, Keith’s real piano expanding the sound, and standout numbers such as Pig's Smokestack Lightnin', Mr. Charlie and the rare Run Rudolph Run. The recording is a soundboard source and is praised for its clear, balanced quality with no reported flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews give five stars, emphasizing both an outstanding performance and a clean soundboard recording; the consistent enthusiasm yields a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No technical complaints; reviewers note clear piano and overall crispness, implying a well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First night of a four‑show run, longer than the others due to radio simulcast; new material that would become Europe '72 is presented with strong pacing and seamless transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Briefly appears on pedal steel (New Riders) and closes with a farewell remark; no specific guitar commentary.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted singing full‑time throughout the show, adding vocal depth.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's real piano is praised for broadening the band’s sound and complementing Jerry nicely.
